jobs.company: Shenzhen Sitianjichuang Education Technology Co., Ltd.

Served as the company's primary frontend developer, maintaining web applications, the corporate website, and a WeChat commerce platform. Rebuilt the corporate website and commerce platform with Vue 2, introduced frontend-backend separation, and supported products serving more than 6,000 users.
